entries.26935f9dedb0ae67: A reportable segment in which subsidiaries carry out service businesses such as computer software development, sales of goods and greening. Aichi Information Systems Co., Ltd. develops computer software, and Aiko Service Co., Ltd. carries out service businesses such as sales of goods and greening. The securities report treats it as 1 of the 5 reportable segments; in the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥2,945 million (up 24.6% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥1,005 million.

entries.5cb830049c4ea264: A reportable segment that makes and sells special steel (hot-rolled materials) and steelmaking materials. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥105,567 million (down 1.1% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥8,160 million, the largest segment profit of the 5 reportable segments. In addition to the Company's manufacturing and sale of special steel, Aichi Ceratec Co., Ltd. and Omi Mining Co., Ltd. produce steelmaking materials, and Aichi Logistics Co., Ltd. transports and stores steel products. The securities report states that although sales volume of special steel, the main product, increased, revenue decreased because of lower selling prices.
entries.61e29f3f736ffdd9: Magnet application products (denture attachments, neodymium anisotropic bonded magnets)
entries.6a3768fd156e4a35: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells electronic functional materials and components, magnet application products, plant activation materials and metal fibers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥22,107 million (up 7.4% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥1,375 million. The main products of electronic functional materials and components are electronic components such as in-vehicle heat dissipation parts made with advanced plating technology, and the amorphous MI sensor, an ultra-compact, ultra-high-sensitivity magnetic sensor. The main products of magnet application products are denture attachments for the medical market and neodymium anisotropic bonded magnets for the automotive and home appliance markets. The securities report states that revenue increased because of higher sales of electronic components.
entries.6dbf9c83d5506c18: A materials maker that produces special steel, stainless steel, forged products and electronic components, mainly for automobiles, and sells them to Toyota Group companies and others.

entries.8b0ca0c7f94725a4: A reportable segment that makes and sells die-forged products (rough-shaped materials for automotive parts, rough-shaped materials for machine parts, etc.) and forging die-machined products. It is the segment with the largest revenue from external customers of the 5 reportable segments. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥134,823 million (up 7.4% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥6,646 million. In addition to the Company's manufacturing and sales in Japan, ASDEX Co., Ltd. makes forging die-machined products, subsidiaries in the Philippines, Thailand, China and Indonesia make and sell die-forged products in Asia, and Aichi Forge USA, Inc. makes and sells die-forged products in North America. The securities report states that revenue increased because of higher sales volume and higher selling prices of die-forged products for automobiles, the main products.

entries.ec946703b7779e57: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells stainless steel and titanium (hot-rolled materials, secondary processed products) and provides engineering for stainless steel structures. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥38,897 million (down 11.7% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥400 million. Aikoh Co., Ltd. sells the Company's products and processes and sells special steel and stainless steel, Aichi Techno Metal Fukaumi Co., Ltd. rolls, secondarily processes and sells stainless steel, and Aichi Korea Co., Ltd. sells the Company's products in Asia. The securities report states that revenue decreased because of lower sales volume and lower selling prices of stainless steel, the main product.
